method: 12 fresh-party Warden/Ranger/Healer or Crusader campaigns across seeds 7,27,42,62,99,2026. Prepared routing; earned drops and shop purchases; training before progressed Path of the Beast. No starting equipment fixture, forced damage or HP/gold grants. Presentation waits skipped. Planner knows layout locations and follows revealed legal movement. Crusader campaign starts with class unlocked. Noncompletions stop the campaign before Path. One combat seed per layout, greedy policy; not human playtests or player win rates.
sampling_notes: Initial cases 27/62/99 ran before UI/pacing changes and detailed shop telemetry. Combat statistics and price tables remain unchanged. Null ledger fields mean unavailable, not zero. Additional 7/42/2026 cases were rerun after fixing a passive-objective UI flag and the harness training-cap handling; script-failed preliminary runs are excluded. The source hashes below are the final review snapshot, not a claim that initial runs used those complete presentation-file bytes.
